note: Lyon County Conservation park on 72-acre Lake Pahoja (no gas motors), 4 mi S + 2 mi W of Larchwood; Lakeview campground is the first on the south side of the road as you enter, Prairie View is at the east end. Swimming beach, boat ramp, paved trail around the lake. --Claude
summary: Rate added: $25/night ($150/week). Season 'seasonal' -> year-round (electric on all year; bathhouses May 1-Oct 15). Confirmed 71 FCFS electric sites (8 with water), showers, dump, 14-night max. Lakeview kept on a camper report; pin was at the lake shore: moved to Lakeview campground (imagery estimate).
flags: SEASON: stored year_round=false (note prose 'Open seasonally') is contradicted: 'The campground is open year-round with electricity on for camping.' Only the bathhouses close (open May 1 - October 15).

FEES: no stored rate; $25 a night, $150 a week, on the county's own campground pages. The park also posts admission ($5 daily, $10 weekend, $25 annual per vehicle); a Campendium camper wrote 'Our nightly rate includes a $5 a day County Park fee', so it is likely folded in, but the county page does not say.

WATERFRONT: lakeview kept, but it rests on one camper report. A Campendium reviewer: 'We may have had one of the best sites in the park, as it was very spacious with a view of the lake.' On NAIP Lakeview's rows sit under canopy; their south end is ~70-100 m from the shore across open lawn with the beach, lodges and volleyball court (day use) between, so on-water is ruled out. Prairie View is farther east, wooded and ~150 m+ from the lake. No official site photos exist (no booking engine).

PIN (~280 m off): stored 43.38400,-96.46750 is at the north shore of the lake's west arm, at the water. The county map places Lakeview between the entrance road and the big lot; proposed location 43.38554,-96.46474 (Lakeview's loops on NAIP, partly under canopy, imagery estimate; Prairie View is ~300 m east).
HOOKUPS: amperage not stated by the county; a Campendium camper wrote '30 and 50 amp'. Left unset.

SEASONAL SITES: 19 permanent seasonal campsites (a separate row on the map, let by drawing; 'no permanent campsites opened up for the 2027 season'). 71 of 90 sites are nightly, so long-stay test 4 passes; a reviewer saw 'some rigs parked in sites and locked up during the week'.

WEBSITE: stored mycountyparks.com page has no campground booking (FCFS only); the county's own page is https://lyoncounty.iowa.gov/conservation/parks/lake_pahoja/lake_pahoja_campground/ . apply.py does not write website.
